snp5.4:1.1: To the one unperturbed, who has seen the roots,
snp5.4:1.3: I have come with a question.
snp5.4:1.4: Because of what have many human seers
snp5.4:1.6: offered sacrifices to devas here in the world?
snp5.4:1.7: I ask you, Blessed One. Please tell me.
snp5.4:2.1: The Buddha: Those many human seers
snp5.4:2.4: who have offered sacrifices to devas here in the world,
snp5.4:2.5: Puṇṇaka, hoping for more of this state of being, offered their sacrifices
snp5.4:3.4: who have offered sacrifices to devas here in the world:
snp5.4:3.5: Have they, Blessed One, heeding the path of sacrifice,
snp5.4:3.6: dear sir, crossed over birth & aging?
snp5.4:3.7: I ask you, Blessed One. Please tell me.
snp5.4:4.3: liked, longed for, so they sacrificed— they longed for sensuality, dependent on gain.
snp5.4:4.4: I tell you: Those who take on the yoke of sacrifice, impassioned with the passion for becoming,
snp5.4:4.5: have not crossed over birth & aging.
snp5.4:5.1: Puṇṇaka: If those who take on the yoke of sacrifice
snp5.4:5.4: then who in the world, dear sir, of beings divine & human
snp5.4:5.6: I ask you, Blessed One. Please tell me.
snp5.4:6.1: The Buddha: He who has fathomed the high & low in the world,
snp5.4:6.3: for whom there is nothing perturbing in the world—
snp5.4:6.5: he, I tell you, has crossed over birth & aging.
